pkgmetadata.longdescription: Vinegar downloads, configures and launches Roblox Studio under Wine, with a GTK4/libadwaita manager for renderer, DXVK, GPU selection and FFlag settings. It ships a small Vulkan layer that works around VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR errors in Studio. The Roblox Player is not supported: its anti-cheat refuses to run under Wine.
